_comment: Copy to config/broker.json on the GPU PC and start the broker by hand: npm run broker. It is the only way to the GPU: every installation's ComfyUI provider points at it ("baseUrl": "http://<this PC>:8190") and ComfyUI listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Requests from this PC need no token (client "local"); every other client sends Authorization: Bearer <its token> ("env:NAME" reads an environment variable). adapters.speech runs the game's voices on the GPU, with the Python environment in packages/gpu-broker/speech/.venv (docs/hosting.md); leave it out for a broker without speech. See docs/gpu-broker.md.
